audit_items.proof_trace: RLS SELECT policy `using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id)` on `attendance.attendances` correctly enforces the invariant for all direct authenticated reads. FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (fix_security_permissions.sql:93) prevents table-owner bypass, and REVOKE ALL from anon (fix_security_permissions.sql:74) eliminates unauthenticated access. The two aggregate summary functions (`get_daily_attendance_counts_for_month`, `get_daily_attendance_details`) are SECURITY INVOKER (not DEFINER), so RLS applies inside them — authenticated callers only see their own rows. The sole SECURITY DEFINER function (`attendance.record_attendance_by_card`) returns only `{type, display_name, discord_uid}` for the tapped card's owner, not raw attendance record arrays, and this disclosure is intentional kiosk design.
